newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market roundup - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady on Tuesday, compared to Monday's close, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand moderate. Seller interest light. Offerings light and current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1175-1325 lbs 69.00-70.00 few 70.50.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1250 lbs 69.00-70.00.
Most cattle delivered to packing plants with weighing conditions equivalent to 3 percent shrink at feedlots with some being bought on a picked up (FOB) basis.
Carcass Basis (weight only) compared to last Friday's close, slaughter steers and heifers steady.
